# Odoo Debug

> Odoo Debug is a free Chrome extension to debug Odoo 18, 19 and 20. It adds a debug panel to the Odoo page itself: debug mode toggle, record and field inspector, view inheritance, RPC log, access rights and record rules, translations, server profiler, code dry runs.

Odoo's developer mode shows what is on the screen. Odoo Debug shows why: which module adds a field, which inherited view made it read-only, which RPC call failed and with what traceback, which record rule blocks a user, which request fires N+1 SQL queries. Made for Odoo developers, functional consultants and administrators.

- Price: free. License: Apache-2.0, source on GitHub. Author: UncleCat (https://unclecatvn.com/).
- Odoo versions: 18, 19 and 20, detected on each page, on any domain (Odoo.sh, on-premise, localhost). Odoo 17 and earlier are not supported.
- Browsers: Chrome, Edge, Brave and other Chromium browsers (Manifest V3). Firefox and Safari are not supported.
- Languages: Arabic, German, English, Spanish, French, Indonesian, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese.
- Privacy: no backend, no analytics, no tracking. It talks only to the Odoo server of the current tab, with the user's own session. Every tab only reads unless the user asks for a write.
- Install: add it from the Chrome Web Store, open an Odoo page while logged in, click the round button at the bottom right or press Alt+Shift+O. Alt+Shift+D turns Odoo's debug mode on or off.

## The nine tabs

- Record: each field's type, value, defining module, and what recomputes it.
- View: why a field is read-only or invisible: the condition, its value now, and the inherited view that set it.
- RPC: every JSON-RPC call of the page with payload, timing, result and Python traceback; edit and resend, or copy as cURL.
- Security: the access right or record rule that refuses a user, and the group that would allow it, tried in a simulation first.
- Translations: pick a text on the page to see its source and where to change it; export .pot / .po.
- Apps: every module an install would bring, auto-installs included.
- Menus: technical screens (models, views, rules, crons) one click away.
- Perf: profiles a request with Odoo's profiler, flags N+1 queries and the line running them.
- Code: dry-run Python or JavaScript; nothing is saved.
